review.finding: The --declared-complexity CLI option has no production caller (the runner passes only --spec); declared = declared_complexity is a no-op alias.
review.suggestion: Remove the option and the merge list; use the parameter directly.

review.finding: classify() does not validate declared_complexity when called directly; apply_floor fails with an opaque ValueError while recheck() names the problem.
review.suggestion: Validate in apply_floor so both entry points raise the same named error.

review.finding: Parser accepted only spaces and ignored trailing punctuation; a scope line such as Complexity: TBD or Complexity: large in free text could fail or floor a unit.
review.suggestion: Allow tabs, treat trailing punctuation as malformed, scan only the header before the first level-2 heading, add tests.

review.finding: The noqa F401 on the _split_flags import is misleading because main() calls it directly.

notes: Fixed: option removed, apply_floor validates, parser header-only with tab and punctuation handling and tests, noqa trimmed. Anti-ratchet respected: diff_risk_recheck.py 303 lines against grandfathered 305.
